subject.title: FizzBuzz Project & Provider Lookup Project (in progress)
details: FizzBuzz Project (https://github.com/RossJiao/fizzbuzz-project): Developed a Python program that prints numbers from 1 to 100, replacing multiples of 3 with Fizz, multiples of 5 with Buzz, and multiples of both with FizzBuzz. Pushed to GitHub with README documentation.

Provider Lookup Project (in progress): Started building a system that allows users to search for and locate healthcare providers. Reviewed data sources including NPI Registry, NPI Files, and NUCC Provider Taxonomy.
MIT 6.0001 Python Lectures: Completed Lectures 1 through 12.

notes: FizzBuzz project completed and pushed to GitHub with full README documentation.
Provider Lookup Project is currently in progress — reviewing NPI data sources and planning system design.
NPI (National Provider Identifier) is a unique identification number for covered healthcare providers in the US.
